0022600101.text: The Golden State Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific, 1 game back, 13th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 6th in the West) in the second game of the 2026-27 season, with the Warriors looking for their first win after dropping their opener on the road. The Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 133-112 victory in Memphis on February 25, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season. Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Memphis has Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions.
